scripts.title: force everyone ragdoll
scripts.script:
-- @build-failed
-- force ragdoll everyone

local runservice, players = game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("Players")

runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    for _, player in players:GetPlayers() do
        if not player or player == players.LocalPlayer or not player.Character then continue end

        player.Character:WaitForChild("System"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Ragdoll"):FireServer(true)
    end
end)
